svg.text: ALL HUG WIDTHS ARE PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATICS.
ROWS WRAP; H1 IS A SINGLE-LINE BASELINE.
ITEM / CHECK / RADIO / ACTION SHARE THE ROW.
SHORTCUT THEN CHECK: ONLY ONE AUTO MARGIN.
KEYBOARD OPENS ON FIRST ENABLED ROW.
SELECT OPENS ON SELECTED / FIRST ENABLED.
SEARCH KEEPS ACTIVE ROW; QUERY PICKS FIRST.
NO SCRIM. COLLISION LOGIC CAN FLIP / SHIFT.
ACTION AND DEFERRED CHECK KEEP THE ROW OPEN.
NOMINAL BLUR ENVELOPE; NOT A CSS CLIP EDGE.
E1 / E2 / E3 TAKE THE MAXIMUM OF BOTH SHADOWS.

g.text: SCALE 1:1 FIXED DETAILS · HUG WIDTH / ROW COUNT SCHEMATIC
RIGHT / START · SEARCH TOP OR BOTTOM
NESTED LIST CAP: ML · SINGLE OR MULTIPLE
H = 2·(B+S1) + Σ ROW HEIGHTS + LABELS + SEPARATORS
COMPOSED HEIGHT SHOWN ONLY; NO FIXED ROW COUNT.

svg.text: SCALE 2:1 FIXED SPACING · WIDTH IS SCHEMATIC
ORDINARY GAP S4 · NESTED SELECT GAP S5.
ACTION: LEAD I1 STAYS FIXED; LABEL RESERVES ITS WIDEST STATE.
CHECK / RADIO: TRAIL I1 RESERVED; DEFERRED LOADER USES THE SAME SLOT.
SUBMENU: TRAIL I1 CHEVRON · SELECT SUMMARY HUG, MAX 50%.
AVAILABLE HEIGHT CLIPS VIA SCROLLER; WIDTH ≤ AW.
SURFACE BLUR IS MATERIAL; SHADOW IS SEPARATE.
ALL PANELS USE THE SAME PORTAL / POSITIONER STACK.
HIGHLIGHT IS INSTANT. NO ROW GEOMETRY TWEEN.
